title: Contract Pricing Desk Note: List Price Step between a Retired Item and Its VendPoint Substitute
content:
When Corbett places a substitute in a retired item's selection on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine, the step in list price between the two items, as the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement records them, sets a share of the substitute's par.

**Rule.** The list price step compares the list price on the substitute's contract price line with the list price on the retired item's contract price line written as a new item carrying the highest change reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence): when the substitute lists at or above the dearer ratio of the retired item, the share is the dearer share; when it lists at or below the cheaper ratio, the share is the cheaper share; otherwise, or when either line carries no list price or a list price of zero, the share is one.

**Figures.** The dearer ratio is 1.25 and the dearer share 0.8; the cheaper ratio is 0.8 and the cheaper share 1.2.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical retired item list price 10.00 USD)

| Substitute list price | Against the retired item | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 12.50 USD | 1.25 times: at the dearer ratio | 0.8 |
| 12.49 USD | Below 1.25 times, above 0.8 times | 1 |
| 8.01 USD | Above 0.8 times | 1 |
| 8.00 USD | 0.8 times: at the cheaper ratio | 1.2 |
| no list price on either line | not compared | 1 |
| 0.00 USD (a list price of zero) | not compared | 1 |

A retired item line with a list price of zero is likewise not compared, and the share is one.
